{{Quote|I trust that Brian looked after you well?|[[Davin DeWitt]], to the [[heroes of Cularin]]|<ref name="Find the Lady">{{LivingForce|Trade Wars: Find the Lady}}</ref>}}
'''Brian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Brian worked as a messenger for [[Davin DeWitt]], the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the [[platform city]] of [[Bayonard]]. When DeWitt's [[Selima DeWitt|daughter]] went missing, he wanted to send the [[heroes of Cularin]] to find her, so he sent Brian to collect them. Brian picked them up in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and then flew them to Bayonard. He then escorted them to DeWitt's house and while they walked there, Brian pointed out the [[Bayonard Institute of Higher Education]] to the heroes.
